naslov: AI Wars Ep. 25: OpenAI, Anthropic staff fear own AI; Meta's Wang warns
opis:
According to Axios, many employees at OpenAI and Anthropic believe their unreleased models can no longer be reliably controlled, and both labs are reportedly debating whether to halt release or even training. The report is based on anonymous sources with no official confirmation. Meanwhile, Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang wrote on X that superintelligence is coming and the industry must take substantially different steps, a sharp turn from Zuckerberg's stance.

naslov: Codex SVG & 3D Design plugin: turn sketches into editable SVG and 3D | AI Tool #31
opis:
A Codex plugin that turns a reference image into an editable SVG or a 3D model in Blender, with changes requested in plain language.

How to try it:
1. Open the plugin page in ChatGPT (link from the video) and enable "SVG & 3D Design" in Codex
2. Drop in a sketch of an icon or mascot for your app
3. Ask for changes in words, e.g. "make the eyes follow the cursor"
4. For 3D, you need Blender installed

Price: check the link (requires a ChatGPT account with Codex)

Official link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1u0hTd86_HU

naslov: datasette-charts: ask an AI agent to chart your Datasette tables | AI Tool #32
opis:
Simon Willison's charting plugin: you ask in chat for a chart from a table, and the agent draws it and opens it in a builder next to the table.

How to try it:
1. Go to agent.datasette.io and sign in with GitHub
2. Type e.g. "Use #stats to show sqlite-utils downloads over time as a chart"
3. Click "Open in the chart builder" and tweak the chart by hand
4. For your own data, install the plugin in a local Datasette

Price: free

Official link: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/24/datasette-charts/

naslov: What is superintelligence? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Superintelligence is a hypothetical AI that beats the best humans at almost everything, not just one task. This week Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang wrote that superintelligence is coming, that AI could soon become "superhumanly good at improving itself," and that the industry must take substantially different steps.
